In which frontend source file are the ConnectRPC service clients created?

content:
q07.

`web/src/connect.ts`

All ConnectRPC service clients are constructed there from a single `createConnectTransport` (`web/src/connect.ts:184`) and exported as module-level singletons — `instanceServiceClient`, `authServiceClient`, `userServiceClient`, `memoServiceClient`, `attachmentServiceClient`, `aiServiceClient`, `shortcutServiceClient`, `identityProviderServiceClient` (`web/src/connect.ts:192-203`). The file also holds a separate `refreshTransport`/`refreshAuthClient` pair (`web/src/connect.ts:65-72`) used for token refresh, kept off the interceptor chain to avoid recursion.
